call_purpose: You had a list of things to sort out: your thank-you page, the landing page buttons on mobile, emails going to spam, your invoices, weekly lesson unlocking, and exporting your student list.
objective: To get your thank-you page, mobile landing page, email domain, invoice name and course lesson schedule working as you want.

resolved.text: You pasted your thank-you page link into the redirect field under the product's After purchase settings and saved it, and a test order now goes to your thank-you page.
You increased the spacing between the two buttons in the mobile view of the page editor, and you confirmed on your phone that they are now separate.

covered.text: For your emails going to spam, we explained that in Email settings you add your domain, get three DNS records, add them at your domain registrar and then click Verify. This is not fully resolved until the records are added and verified.
For your expired EARLYBIRD coupon, we explained that you can change the expiry date in the coupon settings if you decide to extend it. That decision is yours.
We explained that there is a drip schedule setting for lessons, but we are not yet sure whether it works when a course is sold inside a bundle, so this is not resolved yet.
On the AI quiz generator, we are not aware of one being available right now and have no date for it, so please do not plan around it.
We went through how to export your student list: go to Students, click Export and choose CSV, which downloads a file you can open in a spreadsheet.

customer_next_steps.text: Your developer will add the three DNS records at your domain registrar, and once they are added, click Verify in your email settings.

support_next_steps.text: We will check with our billing team about changing the GST name on your invoices from your personal name to your company name, and get back to you. This is not resolved yet.
We will check with our product team whether the drip schedule works for a course sold inside a bundle, and get back to you.
